itinerary.title: Departure via Zurich
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check-out. Train to Zurich airport (about 2 hrs). Tour ends.

itinerary.title: Cilaos – Saint-Denis Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Saint-Denis airport (about 2.5 hrs). Tour ends.
